title: Handoff Lattice: SE + ProServices Weekly Sync — AeroLedger integration
content:
Meeting: SE + ProServices weekly sync
Date: 2028-05-21 10:00 PT (recurring Tue)
Duration: 40m
Facilitator: Maya Rodriguez
Attendees: Maya R., Ethan P., Sofia N., Jonas F., Priya M., AeroLedger SME: Claire H. (30m in)

Purpose
- Triage current integration runway for AeroLedger (private deployment, hybrid VPC).
- Surface risks that need engineering or legal escalation.
- Confirm handoff milestones and owner cadence.

Quick status by pillar
1) Infra & Deployment (Jonas)
- Private deployment image build completed (image v2028.5.17-aero). Smoke tests pass on x86 (non-GPU).
- Blocker: GPU node-sizing for quantized 4-bit model still TBD — requirement from AeroLedger: 200 qps sustained for short-tail queries.
- Action: Jonas to run capacity spike test with continuous-batching enabled, target window 2028-05-24 02:00 PT (infra-night). Need quota request PROSERV-8421 for extra spot pool.

2) Model & Runtime (Ethan)
- Model variant pinned: redwood/llama2-13B-q4f16 (baseline). Local perf: p95 token latency 38ms on A100-40GB with kv-cache warm.
- Concern: some prompts in AeroLedger prompt-set hit long prefix (system + history ~1.2k tokens) => KV cache warmup may dominate first request latency.
- Mitigation: proposed prefix caching for known templates. Spike scheduled 2028-05-23 (Ethan).

3) Security & Compliance (Priya)
- AeroLedger asked for SOC-level audit evidence and KMS integration for customer-managed keys.
- Engineering checklist item: KMS key rotation demo and HSM compatibility notes due 2028-05-28.
- Action: Priya to coordinate with security-ops and provide Confluence stub by 2028-05-24.

4) Integrations & Hand-offs (Sofia)
- Ingest pipeline: chunking/mapping strategy agreed (512-token chunks, overlapping 64). Implementation PR in review (see linked PR).
- Data residency: AeroLedger requires data persist < 24h (cache TTL). Need explicit config toggle in private deploy runtime — ticket created PROSERV-8421-2.

Customer highlight (Claire H. joined)
- AeroLedger reported intermittent 5xxs when model fallback occurs. They are currently routing fallback to hosted variant which has slightly different tokenizer leading to tokenization drift.
- Decision: create consistent tokenizer artifact package to ship with private runtime. Jonas + Ethan to pair on artifact packaging (due 2028-05-26).

Open risks (top 5)
- R1 (High): GPU sizing underestimation -> risk to QPS SLOs. Contingency: enable burst-to-hosted with fallback policy. Product to approve fallback pricing delta. Owner: Maya.
- R2 (High): KMS/HSM interop timeline slipping -> blocks customer go-live. Owner: Priya.
- R3 (Med): Tokenization mismatch between hosted and private -> could cause semantic drift in outputs. Owner: Ethan + Jonas.
- R4 (Med): Ingest chunk overlap causing duplicate context leading to hallucinations in rerank tests. Owner: Sofia.
- R5 (Low): Support rotation for AeroLedger primary contact during holiday window (6/1–6/7). Owner: Jonas (oncall swap).

Decisions made
- Ship with pinned quantized model (q4f16) and plan for A/B with int8 variant if cost needs optimization in Q2 post-go-live. (Owner: Ethan)
- Implement prefix-key cache for recurring templates as short-term latency improvement. (Owner: Ethan)
- Use customer-managed KMS but keep debug keys available for support team behind access control. (Owner: Priya)

Action items (owner — due)
- Jonas: run capacity spike test with extra spot pool; attach results to PROSERV-8421 (2028-05-24).
- Ethan: prototype prefix caching for AeroLedger templates + run perf comparison (2028-05-23).
- Priya: produce KMS/HSM integration checklist + required evidence stub for SOC review (2028-05-24).
- Sofia: merge ingest-chunking PR and validate overlap regression tests (2028-05-25).
- Maya: finalize fallback pricing delta and confirm with product (2028-05-27).
- All: update runbook with new tokenizer packaging steps (small PR) (2028-05-26).

Parking lot / Notes to follow up
- Follow up with Product on SLA wording for burst-to-hosted fallback (Maya).
- Legal to review KMS access policy for support keys (Priya to loop legal).
- Consider adding an observability tag for "aeroleger-req" to make debugging traces filterable in console.

Meeting cadence / next meeting
- Same time next Tue 10:00 PT. Proposed smaller triage Wednesday 9am PT only if spike test shows capacity issues.

Appendix: quick metrics snapshot (from staging run 2028-05-20)
- P95 token latency: 38ms (A100 warm), P99: 120ms (cold first-token)
- Median throughput observed (single node): 160 qps with continuous batching (simulated prompts mix).
- Error rate (5xx) during hosted fallback test: 0.9% (root cause: tokenizer mismatch)

Notes / freeform
- Claire: "We love the dashboard view — can we get a per-route token-cost estimate in the console?" — reassign to product-hosted-api roadmap.
- Jonas: need to lock down image signing process for private artifacts before we hand binary to AeroLedger (security ask).
- Ethan: experiment idea — apply lightweight output filtering at runtime to mitigate overlap hallucinations (spike after onramp).

Next steps: owners to update tickets by COB 2028-05-24. If any item slips, escalate in #se-proservices channel and flag for Wed triage.
